overview.en: The catalogue name Pristis perotteti is now treated as a synonym of Pristis pristis, the largetooth sawfish; this entry therefore describes that currently recognized species rather than a separate taxon.
overview.fr: Le nom du catalogue, Pristis perotteti, est aujourd’hui traité comme un synonyme de Pristis pristis, le poisson-scie à grandes dents ; cette fiche décrit donc l’espèce actuellement reconnue, et non un taxon distinct.

identification.en: This is a ray, not a shark: its flattened head and long, toothed rostrum give sawfishes their distinctive outline.
identification.fr: C’est une raie, et non un requin : sa tête aplatie et son long rostre denté donnent aux poissons-scies leur silhouette caractéristique.

habitat.en: It occurs in tropical river systems and estuaries. Adults also use coastal waters.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente les rivières tropicales et les estuaires. Les adultes utilisent aussi les eaux côtières.

diet.en: It feeds on fishes and bottom-dwelling invertebrates, using its saw to disturb sediment or strike at prey.
diet.fr: Il se nourrit de poissons et d’invertébrés du fond, et utilise son rostre pour remuer le sédiment ou frapper ses proies.

behavior.en: The long rostrum is a hunting tool as well as a conspicuous identifying feature.
behavior.fr: Le long rostre est un outil de chasse autant qu’un signe d’identification visible.

reproduction.en: Its life history is poorly known; Australian accounts describe slow maturation and low reproductive output.
reproduction.fr: Son cycle de vie est mal connu ; les sources australiennes décrivent une maturation lente et une faible production de jeunes.

ecology.en: Its use of rivers, estuaries and coastal waters links freshwater and marine ecosystems.
ecology.fr: Sa fréquentation des rivières, des estuaires et des eaux côtières relie les écosystèmes d’eau douce et marins.

conservation.en: The global assessment of Pristis pristis is Critically Endangered; entanglement in fishing gear and loss or alteration of habitat are major concerns.
conservation.fr: L’évaluation mondiale de Pristis pristis le classe « En danger critique » ; les captures dans les engins de pêche et la perte ou la modification de l’habitat sont des préoccupations majeures.

facts: The Australian government account describes juveniles in freshwater, feeding on fishes and benthic invertebrates, and a poorly understood life history with late maturity and low fecundity.

uncertainties: The catalog retains the historical name P. perotteti although the current IUCN taxonomic treatment groups it under P. pristis. Information on ecology and status is therefore presented for the accepted species.
review_note: Verified the inventory ID/group and checked IUCN taxonomy against Florida Museum and Australian government material, with a Spanish-language aquarium source for feeding. The account avoids treating P. perotteti as a separate currently accepted species.
